_doc: GENERATED by 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-fleet-agents.py from every app's build.json::fleet_agents (do not edit; run data/regen.sh or the script's write). Read by Cloud SuperApp > Configs > Apps > Agents through BuildConfig.FLEET_AGENTS_B64.

agents.name: Fleet updater
agents.trigger: periodic (build.json auto_update interval) plus a kick 30 s after launch
agents.summary: libs:updater UpdateWorker: checks every fleet app against the release and updates what is newer.

agents.name: Update now
agents.trigger: on demand (Store ▸ Update, the update notification)
agents.summary: libs:updater one-shot UpdateWorker run when the owner asks for an update.

agents.name: App installer
agents.trigger: on demand (an Install or Update tap on a fleet app)
agents.summary: libs:updater ApkInstallWorker: downloads a fleet APK, verifies it and installs it.

agents.name: Update All
agents.trigger: on demand (Configs ▸ Actions ▸ Update All)
agents.summary: libs:updater BatchForegroundService: runs a whole-fleet update in the foreground.

agents.name: Privileged plane
agents.trigger: app start, boot and every ADB pairing
agents.summary: PrivilegedPlaneWorker: connects the shell channel and grants the declared privileged permissions.

agents.name: Wireless debugging keeper
agents.trigger: periodic while the keep-alive switch is on
agents.summary: WirelessDebugKeeper: re-arms Wireless debugging and reconnects the channel when the platform clears it.

agents.name: Notification listener
agents.trigger: always on once notification access is granted
agents.summary: PhoneNotificationListenerService: feeds the phone's notifications into Notify and the badges.

agents.name: Peer Control status
agents.trigger: while a KDE Connect peer is paired
agents.summary: KdeStatusService: keeps the peer link and its status notification up.

agents.name: GitHub engine
agents.trigger: on demand (Account ▸ GitHub, the Store's Commits feeds)
agents.summary: Cloud-Lib-Gh.apk, bound by handshake (build.json engines.gh).

agents.name: Feed engine
agents.trigger: on demand (the RSS pane)
agents.summary: Cloud-Lib-Feed.apk, bound by handshake (build.json engines.feed).

agents.name: Browser AI agent
agents.trigger: on demand (AI chat on the open page)
agents.summary: Reads and acts on the open page with the declared tools; every tool that changes something asks first.

status.reason: the agent runs inside the open tab; Cloud Browser exposes no status for it

agents.name: Browser agent door
agents.trigger: called by Cloud Search agents
agents.summary: agentapi: opens a URL for the person, or reads a page text read-only (#913).

agents.name: Claude
agents.trigger: on demand (a chat turn in Cloud Code Agents or Chat, or Cloud Search chat)
agents.summary: the subscription claude CLI behind claude-superset-api; an Anthropic catalogue row is passed as the CLI model

status.reason: live state is the gateway /health over the mesh (HTTP); the SuperApp does not call it

agents.name: Hermes
agents.trigger: on demand (a chat turn in Cloud Code Agents or Chat, or Cloud Search chat)
agents.summary: Nous Hermes Agent (native API once HERMES_API_KEY is wired, else the Hermes model behind the gateway's MCP loop); the gateway picks the model

status.reason: live state is the gateway /health over the mesh (HTTP); the SuperApp does not call it

agents.name: Goose
agents.trigger: on demand (a chat turn in Cloud Code Agents or Chat, or Cloud Search chat)
agents.summary: Block's goose, the gateway's default agent; GOOSE_MODEL

status.reason: live state is the gateway /health over the mesh (HTTP); the SuperApp does not call it

agents.name: OpenClaw
agents.trigger: on demand (a chat turn in Cloud Code Agents or Chat, or Cloud Search chat)
agents.summary: OpenClaw (MIT), cloud-agi-openclaw on oci-apps since 2026-10-13: its gateway on 127.0.0.1:18789 only, reached through the fleet gateway's openclaw mode, which forwards only the messages and the agent target (openclaw/default). It runs the model its own config names (the fleet model through the gateway's OpenRouter face), with its own tool plugins; no fleet MCP servers are configured in it, and the gateway sends no reasoning field.

status.reason: live state is the gateway /health over the mesh (HTTP); the SuperApp does not call it

agents.name: DeepSeek Harness
agents.trigger: on demand (a chat turn in Cloud Code Agents or Chat, or Cloud Search chat)
agents.summary: The DeepSeek harness: a gateway MODE (no service of its own, fleet null), DeepSeek's models on OpenRouter driven through the gateway's MCP tool loop (callOpenRouterAgentic). Text only: DeepSeek's chat models take no images. No native web search; web comes from the fleet MCP tools when present.

status.reason: live state is the gateway /health over the mesh (HTTP); the SuperApp does not call it

agents.name: Screenshot agent
agents.trigger: new screenshots (incremental pass by ScreenshotAgentWorker)
agents.summary: OCRs and labels every screenshot on the phone with on-device ML and writes the contract in data/agent-screenshots-contract.json.

agents.name: Mail agent door
agents.trigger: called by Cloud Search agents
agents.summary: AgentMailProvider: read-only messages and bodies for the draft agents (#913).

agents.name: RS_House-Purchase
agents.trigger: on demand (Run on the agent page); reads alert mail and listings, writes drafts only
agents.summary: Reads your ImmoScout24, Immowelt and Kleinanzeigen alert mails for homes for sale, opens each new listing, and drafts a viewing request from your template.

status.reason: runs and drafts are kept inside Cloud Search; it exposes no provider for them yet

agents.name: Screenshot events agent
agents.trigger: new Screenshot agent records from Cloud Drive (read past its own cursor)
agents.summary: Finds events in Cloud Drive screenshot records and offers them under Invites; accepted ones land in the agents calendar.

status.reason: its on/off switch and last scan live in Cloud Tasks private preferences; Cloud Tasks has no provider for them yet
